name: Raven's Progressive Matrices AI Benchmark
description: A visual reasoning benchmark based on Raven's Progressive Matrices, where models must infer abstract relational rules from image panels and select the correct completion. It tests nonverbal analogical and pattern reasoning.
evaluation_method: Multiple-choice accuracy on the correct matrix completion option.
notes: No author list was provided in the metadata. Raven-style benchmarks are widely used for assessing abstract reasoning in vision models and multimodal systems.
